findings.detail: Direct-lending rows with blank extracted interest_rate have explicit Reference Rate and Spread values in the source schedule, for example AB Centers DDT/Revolver at S + 5.25% and Any Hour DDT at S + 5.00%.

rationale: The flag reports only 67.5% rate fill for 163 direct-lending units, and the bundled holdings slice shows sampled direct-lending DDT/revolver rows with blank interest_rate. Raw source rows in the schedule of investments contain a Reference Rate and Spread column with populated rates for those same instruments, e.g. AB Centers Acquisition Corporation DDT and Revolver both show S + 5.25%, and Any Hour LLC DDT shows S + 5.00%. The missing extracted interest_rate values therefore reflect an extraction/column-mapping gap rather than absent source disclosure.
